description: This file defines the 'ChiSquaredDistribution' class, implementing the chi-squared distribution as part of the Apache Commons Math library. It includes constructors, distribution properties, and methods for density, cumulative probability, and statistical metrics.

classes.name: ChiSquaredDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the chi-squared distribution providing probability density function, cumulative distribution function, and statistical properties, with constructors allowing configuration of degrees of freedom and accuracy.

methods.name: getDegreesOfFreedom
methods.description: Returns the degrees of freedom of the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function at a given point.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the density at a given point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative distribution function for a given value.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution, equal to the degrees of freedom.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution, which is twice the degrees of freedom.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution's support, which is 0.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support, which is positive infinity.

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates support lower bound is inclusive (true).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates support upper bound is exclusive (false).
